messages:
mara (docs): Opening a small PR to add PKCS#11 path examples for RHEL/Debian and a quick test snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5050
jaime (eng-install): Please include exact env examples and one-liner test using pkcs11-tool. We keep hitting path mismatches in customer installs.
samir (infra): Suggest listing both common paths and a fallback discovery command: `find / -name "libsofthsm2.so" 2>/dev/null || find / -name "libpkcs11*" 2>/dev/null` and mention library arch differences (/usr/lib vs /usr/lib64).
lina (security): Add a security note to ensure the PKCS#11 lib is from a trusted package and show `sha256sum` verification of the binary. Also include a short line about file permissions (root-only) for the module and token files.
mara (docs): Draft snippet added to PR: ```bash
# example env for Debian
export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
# example env for RHEL
export PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/pkcs11/softhsm2.so
# quick test
pkcs11-tool --module "$PKCS11_LIB" -L
```
mara (docs): I'll add the discovery command and permission checks, plus a note to verify the library checksum. CI-bot: PR #5050 lint OK, link-checker: 1 broken anchor.
jaime (eng-install): Quick +1. If you can, add one line for systemd unit env example so installers can copy-paste.
mara (docs): Will add `Environment=PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/pkcs11/softhsm2.so` example in the unit section and merge after CI fixes. Thanks!"
